query: What policies cover human-AI configurations and oversight of AI systems?

matched_chunks.title: 7. Human-AI Configuration
matched_chunks.section_path: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile > Overview of Risks Unique to or Exacerbated by GAI > 7. Human-AI Configuration
matched_chunks.applicability: Companion profile; supplements and does not replace NIST.AI.100-1
matched_chunks.snippet: 7. Human-AI Configuration. Arrangements of or interactions between a human and an AI system which can result in the human inappropriately anthropomorphizing GAI systems or experiencing algorithmic aversion, automation bias, over-reliance, or emotional entanglement with GAI systems.

parent.title: Overview of Risks Unique to or Exacerbated by GAI
